mapper.select: SELECT comment_no, post_no, writer_email, nickname, parent_comment_no, content, del_flag, reg_time, mod_time FROM tbl_community_comment WHERE post_no = #{postNo} ORDER BY reg_time ASC, comment_no ASC
SELECT image_no, comment_no, file_name, video, ord FROM tbl_community_comment_image WHERE comment_no = #{commentNo} ORDER BY ord
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_community_comment (post_no, writer_email, nickname, parent_comment_no, content) VALUES (#{postNo}, #{writerEmail}, #{nickname}, #{parentCommentNo}, #{content})
INSERT INTO tbl_community_comment_image (comment_no, file_name, video, ord) VALUES (#{commentNo}, #{fileName}, #{video}, #{ord})
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_community_comment SET content = #{content}, mod_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE comment_no = #{commentNo}
